scope: Pure exact initial-seed storage fixture; no physical source, RHS, Newton, stage map, Jacobian or audit

checks.name: unmarked prior is returned by identity
all state and height Float64 bits including negative zero restore
complete nested parameter encoding preserves negative zero and undefined
marked restoration is idempotent without changing exact bytes
the original guard permits only original I/O differences
the complete stage identity is mandatory and verified
tampered authoritative binary payload is rejected
tampered exact parameter encoding is rejected
marked incomplete or accepted metadata is rejected
missing initial states never construct a different warm guess
nonfinite complete input and invalid source manifests are rejected
repeated identical seed is retained and a conflicting seed is not overwritten
actual-size 577 by 48 byte layout round-trips completely
